title: Memory Record
description: A survivor signal persisted as institutional memory. Wraps the original signal with lifecycle metadata — strength, recall count, consolidation history.

formed_at.description: ISO timestamp of initial memory formation

strength.description: Memory strength — decays over time, reinforced by recall hits

recall_count.description: How many times this memory was matched by recall

last_recalled_at.description: ISO timestamp of last recall match

consolidation_count.description: How many consolidation cycles this memory has survived

source_instance.description: Cascade instance ID that formed this memory

classification.description: Signal classification from cascade or LLM

content_hash.description: SHA256 of normalized signal content for dedup

feature_vector.description: Extracted numeric features for similarity matching
